cards.meaning: a steady, continuing slide downward (gradual decline, not a sudden crash)
cards.example: Sa kabila ng mga pangako ng gobyerno, hindi pa rin napipigilan ang pagdausdos ng piso.
cards.exampleMeaning: Despite the government's promises, the peso's slide still hasn't been stopped.
cards.note: Mula sa 'dausdos' (padulasan). Proseso, hindi isang sandali: iba sa 'pagbagsak' (biglang lagapak). Pormal sa balitang pang-ekonomiya (pagdausdos ng piso/PSEi) pero puwede rin sa araw-araw (pagdausdos ng grado).
cards.tiesTo: PSEi falls 2% to lowest close since May 2020; peso at 63.94

cards.example: Umaasa ang Malacañang na mananatiling tapat ang mga kaalyado nito habang dinidinig ang badyet.
cards.exampleMeaning: Malacañang hopes its allies will stay loyal while the budget is being heard.
cards.note: May kasunduan at obligasyon; iba sa 'kakampi' (pang-araw-araw, laro o away). Gamit sa diplomasya (magkaalyado ang PH at US) at sa pulitika sa loob (mga kaalyado ng Pangulo sa Kongreso).
cards.tiesTo: Trump in Manila for ASEAN-US summit; Marcos-Trump bilateral

cards.meaning: to send / release a signal (telegraph intent)
cards.example: 央行回笼资金，释放了谨慎的信号。
cards.examplePinyin: Yāngháng huílóng zījīn, shìfàngle jǐnshèn de xìnhào.
cards.exampleMeaning: By draining funds, the central bank sent a cautious signal.
cards.note: 书面语(政策/财经评论)。搭配:释放+积极/谨慎/鹰派+信号。近义:表明 只陈述事实;释放信号 暗含意图与受众(有人要去解读)。
cards.tiesTo: PBOC net drains 300bn yuan of medium-term funds in November

cards.meaning: at the cost of …; at the expense of …
cards.example: 稳定汇率不能以经济增长为代价。
cards.examplePinyin: Wěndìng huìlǜ bù néng yǐ jīngjì zēngzhǎng wéi dàijià.
cards.exampleMeaning: Stabilising the exchange rate cannot come at the cost of economic growth.
cards.note: 书面语,略带批评:取舍是选择、代价真实。搭配:以+增长/环境/健康+为代价。近义:牺牲(动词,更情绪化);付出代价(承受后果)。
cards.tiesTo: PBOC protects yuan ahead of Shenzhen summit at the cost of easing
